description: Engineering change requests across the programmes.
data_classification: SIMULATED ENTERPRISE ARTEFACT - not OEM, customer or proprietary data

records.title: HV cell capacity uplift 68Ah to 75Ah
records.description: Introduce a higher energy density prismatic cell raising usable pack energy from 78.0 kWh to 86.0 kWh at unchanged pack envelope. Cell chemistry moves from NMC622 to NMC811.

records.title: Front friction material change to low-copper compound
records.description: Replace the current front brake friction compound with a low-copper formulation to meet market restrictions on restricted substances.

records.title: Front lower control arm bushing supplier transfer
records.description: Transfer front lower control arm rear bushing production from the incumbent plant to a second-source plant to secure capacity.

records.title: Inverter calibration release v4.2
records.description: Release inverter calibration v4.2 revising the thermal derate map and torque ramp shaping to improve continuous power availability.

records.title: HVAC compressor displacement increase 5cc to 7cc
records.description: Introduce a higher displacement electric compressor to improve cabin cool-down and battery chiller capacity at high ambient.

records.title: Wheel and tyre change 19in to 20in on top trim
records.description: Introduce a 20 inch wheel and 255/45R20 tyre on the top trim level, replacing the 19 inch wheel and 235/55R19 tyre.

records.title: HV harness re-route around rear subframe
records.description: Re-route the HV battery to inverter cable to resolve a packaging clash with the revised rear subframe bracket.

records.title: Addition of DC charge inlet temperature sensor
records.description: Add an NTC temperature sensor to the DC charge inlet contacts and introduce a charge current derate function based on measured contact temperature.

records.title: BMS cell balancing algorithm update
records.description: Update the BMS balancing algorithm to shorten convergence time and reduce residual cell voltage spread after long parked periods.

records.title: Cooling plate braze process change to controlled atmosphere furnace
records.description: Change the cooling plate braze process from the current vacuum furnace to a controlled atmosphere furnace at the supplier to increase throughput.

records.title: Steering ECU microcontroller lifecycle replacement
records.description: Replace the steering ECU microcontroller with the successor device following an end-of-life notification from the semiconductor supplier.

records.title: Rear subframe bushing durometer change
records.description: Increase rear subframe isolation bushing durometer to address a low frequency road noise concern.

records.title: Catalyst precious metal loading reduction
records.description: Reduce precious metal loading on the close-coupled catalyst to offset raw material cost increases.

records.title: 12V battery relocation to rear load floor
records.description: Relocate the 12V battery from the front compartment to the rear load floor to improve front axle load margin.
